title: clAIrity live artifact provenance
sourceSummary: Preview data is a compact local sample dataset representing image, video, audio, and webpage/social-post scans.
transformationNotes: Normalized each sample into label, media type, source, safety score, status, finding, and next step.
Added separate history and settings/privacy screens while keeping app and extension surfaces split.
Expanded result detail states for image, video, audio, and text scan previews.
Kept copy short and consumer-readable for kids, families, and older adults.
Excluded user media, private auth material, provider output envelopes, and sensitive fields.
refreshNotes: Future refreshes should update data.json only; template.html preserves the presentation and interaction structure.
